page_title: Jutsu Studio: Free Higgsfield Desktop App for Mac

sources.entry: Jutsu Studio - Open-source, unofficial Higgsfield client for creating AI videos and images with Seedance, Kling and Genjutsu, with every result kept on your disk. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jutsuhq/jutsu-studio) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Jutsu Studio
summary.one_liner: Jutsu Studio is a free, open-source, unofficial Mac desktop app for creating AI videos and images through Higgsfield, with Genjutsu, Seedance, Kling and other models.
use_cases: Transfer motion from a reference video to a new clip
Swap objects or restyle a video with AI
Batch-queue AI video generations on a Mac
Keep a local archive of AI-generated takes
Draft low-resolution renders before final 1080p output
Export AI clips to ProRes or H.264 for editing
summary.what_it_does: Jutsu Studio is a macOS client that sends generation jobs to Higgsfield's servers for models such as Genjutsu, Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 Motion Control, Kling O3, Wan 3.0, Cinema Studio 4.0 and MiniMax H3. It handles everything around the generation on the Mac: it uploads only a chosen 4–30 second range, converts any video with AVFoundation to fit Higgsfield's 200 MiB limit, and runs a background queue with menu bar progress and notifications. Each result is downloaded and stored locally with its source, prompt, cost and request IDs, and can be exported as ProRes 422 or H.264. The app shows the price before each job runs, with an optional daily spending cap and a spending report with CSV export.
notable: Unofficial, open-source Higgsfield client; sign-in via Higgsfield OAuth with tokens kept in macOS Keychain
Draft-then-final workflow: 480p drafts, with 720p or 1080p finals only for kept takes
Local library that keeps results after Higgsfield's download links expire
Generations are billed by Higgsfield at its own prices; the app adds no fee
caveats: Generating requires an internet connection and a Higgsfield account or API key; the queue pauses offline
Mac only; no Windows or iPhone version
Some models are API-key only or account only
Generations are paid to Higgsfield per its pricing
